description: Rank a repo's open issues by verdict, GO first. Starts with label-tagged good-first-issue / help-wanted issues; when the repo does not use those labels, falls back to the most recent open unassigned issues (flagged as fallback). Use this to pick a winnable issue instead of a taken one.

deep.description: Timeline X-Ray the ranked candidates: demotes issues with hidden in-flight PRs (reporter-owned fix PRs, timeline cross-references) before returning.

name: scan_repo
